answer: A sybil tax stops anyone who tries to forge identities: each new identity pays a flat 45-credit tax, never refunded. Each receipt binds one key in a public atlas; no receipt, no rewards, so each extra identity climbs the same cost ridge again. To forge 1,000 costs 1,000 x 45 = 45,000 credits against a 40,000-credit pool, a sure loss. An honest agent pays 45 once and keeps its full share; a tax-pooling ring sharing one receipt loses them all.
